text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! Those plushies are Cuties,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross points toward a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The pipsqueaks back home said
somethin'
about 'em bein' all the rage at
school.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But... how many tries is it gonna take to
nab one?
If I get it first try, that's only a
hundred yen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It could set me back upwards of 200—no, 1,000 yen! That'd be a tragedy...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why am I jinxin' it?! I gotta go in
expectin'
to win one!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya do? You're makin' it sound like ya
got
somethin' special lined up. C'mon,
spill.

Well, I've got some great info for...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What?! Seriously?! You're willin' to shell
out
hard-earned coins for me?

I'll give it a shot in your place,...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Tamamo Cross still flustered, I
insert a coin
into the machine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer, you're really somethin', ya
know that?
Guh... Okay, I'm cheerin' for
ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
